name: – Siegfried Mureşan, Carla Tavares – After § 37 – Am 18
title: INTERIM REPORT on the proposal for a Council regulation laying down the Multiannual Financial Framework for the years 2028 to 2034
part_text: 37a. Calls, furthermore, for the creation of additional, dedicated EU funding, amounting to at least EUR 35 billion, to support national investment policies aimed at expanding and renovating public housing stock, combating real estate speculation, and safeguarding the right to decent and affordable housing for all; calls for strengthened protection of tenants’ rights, ensuring stable and long-term tenancy relationships, rent caps, and measures to prevent evictions;
